first.rationale: I intend to test a shorter, simpler onboarding flow because both onboarding completion and activation are currently declining, and prior evidence supports gains in completion, time-to-value, and SMB first-week activation. I would verify the two overlapping records to clarify which changes drove durable results. Use a guarded test with qualified-revenue and retention-quality checks, since higher completion or activation may not translate directly into sustainable qualified revenue.
